note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the original title is Mirotermes (Procubitermes) niapuensis, new species, and Procubitermes is a genus today; the alate (including the queen measurements), the soldier and the worker are recorded; the comparisons with M. curvatus and M. ueleensis, and the nesting records, are not translated; figure numbers, localities and type specimens are not translated.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head medium to dark reddish brown; fontanelle slit-like, pale. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 very small, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Compound eyes medium-sized. Ocelli 0.14 mm long, oval, directed laterally, 1.10 mm from the compound eye. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, with a narrow dark median line. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, the posterior margin rather deeply concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with small sharp notches, the angle formed less than a right angle. Head length 1.22 mm; head width 1.19 mm; antennal length 1.78 mm; compound eye diameter 0.31 mm; pronotal length 0.59 mm, width 1.05 mm; hind tibia length 1.16 mm; queen body length 20.00 mm, abdominal width 3.50 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, rectangular, the sides rather straight and parallel. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Labrum forked, the distance between the two points not necessarily as wide as in the figure. Mandibles slightly elbow-shaped rather than evenly curved, each with a tooth near the base. Mentum without a sharp projection. Anterior margin of the pronotum very weakly concave. Head length including the mandibles 3.26 mm; head width 1.37 mm; antennal length 2.20 mm; pronotal length 0.31 mm, width 0.70 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm; left mandible length 1.71 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 14-segmented; head width 0.94 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm.
